rationale: Update discovery/deployment and vulnerability remediation are conventional patch-management functions, but the method for ranking vulnerabilities by risk is unspecified and may be AI-dependent. No affirmative AI signal is given, so non_ai is the best-supported forced choice.
evidence_spans: discovering and deploying 3rd party application updates and prioritize and remediate the vulnerabilities that pose the most risk to organization.
conflict_response: The concrete update-management functions support conventional software, but the risk-prioritization method is not stated. I do not invent deterministic rules or treat prioritization as proof of AI; because its applicability is ambiguous, the binary negative remains weak/forced.
